article.title: Pronominaladverbio worauf
article.part: Discurso referido y pronominaladverbios — Indirekte Rede und Pronominaladverbien
article.chapter: Pronominaladverbien: da(r)- y wo(r)- — Pronominaladverbien: da(r)- und wo(r)-

claims.summary: Worauf is a pronominal adverb formed from 'wor- + auf'. It represents in questions or relative relations a complement with 'auf' whose referent is an object, expectation, activity, or situation not personal.
Worauf is used in expressions like 'auf etwas warten', 'auf etwas hoffen', 'sich auf etwas freuen', and 'auf etwas achten'. It can also link to an antecedent.
Worauf can link to a non-personal referent (e.g., 'Auf wen wartest du?') and may also link to a personal antecedent (e.g., 'Das ist etwas, worauf wir lange gewartet haben').
Worauf does not have a single Spanish equivalent and can correspond to 'a qué', 'en qué', 'qué', or other natural formulations.
